نتناقس (form VI)
# نَتَنَاقَسُ (natanāqasu) /na.ta.naː.qa.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
# نَتَنَاقَسَ (natanāqasa) /na.ta.naː.qa.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
# نَتَنَاقَسْ (natanāqas) /na.ta.naː.qas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
